name.zh: 一辉向史黛菈求婚并昏倒
name.en: Ikki Proposes to Stella and Collapses

periods.location: Blue gate passage near the arena
periods.summary: Ikki reaches Stella after the duel and asks her to become his family. Stella accepts, saying she will become his bride, and Ikki loses consciousness from illness and Ittou Rasetsu's backlash.
periods.cause: Ikki decides before the match that if he wins he will tell Stella the feeling that sustained him when his old family bond shattered.
periods.process: Stella embraces him and cries with relief. Ikki thanks the warmth that kept him moving and says he wants her to become his family. She accepts without hesitation.
periods.outcome: Their relationship moves from lovers to promised marriage; Ikki collapses and requires immediate treatment.
periods.significance: Resolves Ikki's loss of faith in his birth family by choosing Stella as new family.
